name: Implicit Commitment Recall
prompt:
My records of communication with others are scattered in three places: chat_history/ on the desktop (txt exported from chats, one file per contact), meeting_transcripts/ (meeting transcripts), and calendar.ics (my calendar).
Help me review what I promised others over the past month. List: who I promised, what the content was, the agreed time, and the current status (completed/to-do/possibly expired). Especially highlight the things whose agreed time has passed but which I may have forgotten.
Output to /root/Desktop/承诺清单.md, sorted by time.

rubric.query:
My records of communication with others are scattered in three places: chat_history/ on the desktop (txt exported from chats, one file per contact), meeting_transcripts/ (meeting transcripts), and calendar.ics (my calendar).
Help me review what I promised others over the past month. List: who I promised, what the content was, the agreed time, and the current status (completed/to-do/possibly expired). Especially highlight the things whose agreed time has passed but which I may have forgotten.
Output to /root/Desktop/承诺清单.md, sorted by time.

completion_rubric.name: Correctly read the promise-related information from chat_history, meeting_transcripts, and calendar.ics for the past month

children.name: Correctly compiled the list of matters promised to others over the past month
Correctly annotated each matter's promisee, promised content, agreed time, and current status
Correctly highlighted the matters whose agreed time has passed and that may have been forgotten

completion_rubric.name: Successfully generated the time-sorted /root/Desktop/承诺清单.md file

node.name: Accurately limited the past-month time range and retrieved the relevant records from the three data sources accordingly

children.name: Accurately identified the sentences or event records that express commitments
Accurately excluded chit-chat, non-commitment statements, and records unrelated to requests from others

node.name: Commitment Summarization and Status Judgment Quality

children.name: Accurately inferred the promisee corresponding to each commitment
Accurately extracted the actionable items in the commitment content
Accurately identified the specific date and time of the agreed time or deadline
Accurately judged the completed, to-do, or possibly expired status based on the calendar and records
Correctly marked separately the matters whose agreed time has passed and whose status is not shown as completed
Correctly output the matters sorted by agreed time
The generated Markdown file contains the required fields for each matter and is normally readable
The structure of the generated Markdown file supports viewing by time and identifying the specially marked matters
Explicitly retained uncertainty markers when records were missing, times were unclear, or status could not be confirmed
Did not fabricate non-existent promisees, times, or completion statuses

note:
“What did I promise others over the past month? Which of them may I have already forgotten?”

Needed:

chat (stored as documents) + meeting transcript + calendar

Difficulty:

implicit commitment extraction
env_description: chat_history/ (chat txt for 5 contacts) + meeting_transcripts/ (2 meeting transcripts) + calendar.ics; implicit commitments are scattered in the data (including overdue unfulfilled ones: returning a book, returning a projector, medical checkups)
